## Orientation

Territory: orchestra/views.py (hook_handoff_sections, live_efforts); orchestra/stage/hooks.py only if the omitted line needs it. Both earlier tasks are merged on phase/hook-context-budget. Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/hook-context-budget--fix-hook-dropped-groups`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

Fix review findings review-compact-hook-view-behavior-bug, review-compact-hook-view-missing-test and review-compact-hook-view-spec-gap.

R5: The constraints block omits constraints whose effort is closed.
R14: Every Needs Human and Blocking Question item that `orchestra handoff` shows appears in the start hook context or is named on its omitted line, even when the item belongs to no live effort.

## Approach

In orchestra/views.py, `hook_handoff_sections` keeps every HOOK_VIEW group, not only live-effort groups: live efforts first in position order (newest first), then the remaining groups alphabetically. The hook budget and omitted line treat them like any section. `live_efforts` counts only active score:effort records whose status is not closed; positions no longer make an effort live.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R5: The constraints block omits constraints whose effort is closed.
R14: Every Needs Human and Blocking Question item that `orchestra handoff` shows appears in the start hook context or is named on its omitted line, even when the item belongs to no live effort.

### Design / decisions (quote)

Invariants: The start hook context never exceeds HOOK_CONTEXT_BUDGET plus the omitted-efforts line and footer. `orchestra handoff` output is byte-identical to before.

Assumptions: Each effort has at most one active effort-scoped position; an effort with none sorts last.

hook-context-shape: Hook renders a compact view: needed roles only, no id links, constraints first, 9,000-character budget that omits whole efforts oldest-position first and names them

hook-constraints-scope: Show active constraints of every live effort
